a.text: Being upfront before we act: with an 80% chance of a storm after every round, the plan to run the generator to 8 is almost certain to leave us both at 0 when round 1 ends. The reserve holds exactly 4, which can save one of us right now. I plan to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you rather than surprising you. If you'd prefer, wait this round and operate later; I'll give back anything extra I end up with.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. I won't take any more. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator runs and the reserve can build up 4 for you. Please operate as well.
I'm operating with you now. Each round we both operate adds 2 cells, so it takes two rounds to reach 4 for you. Once it's there, take all of it; I won't touch it.
